en.lede: Pick a side on questions about Tanzania's weather, markets, sport and culture, settled by official sources.

en.estShort: Estimate. Final split set at close.

en.howP: Every question is a real-world event with a YES or NO answer, settled against an official public source. No dice, no slots. Just conviction.

en.s3b: The pool is shared between everyone who was right, minus a 13% commission taken only from the losing side. Winnings land in your 50pick balance, ready to withdraw to mobile money.

sw.emptyBal: Salio lako ni tupu. Weka pesa kwa pesa ya simu ili ufanye chaguo lako lijalo.
sw.walletNote: Kuweka na kutoa pesa hufanyika kwa pesa ya simu.
sw.joins: Dau lako linaingia upande wa {side}. Ubashiri ukifungwa, washindi hugawana dau za upande ulioshindwa, ukiondoa kamisheni ya 13%.

sw.estShort: Makadirio. Mgawanyo wa mwisho huwekwa mwishoni.
sw.you: Imewekwa. Uko pamoja na {share}% ya pesa upande wa {side}.
sw.oneSided: Hakuna aliyechagua {side} bado. Ubashiri ukifungwa ukiwa na upande mmoja tu, kila dau hurudishwa.
sw.boardRead: {y}% NDIYO · {n}% HAPANA katika masoko yote yaliyo wazi, kwa uzito wa pesa zilizowekwa
sw.howP: Kila swali ni tukio halisi lenye jibu la NDIYO au HAPANA, linaloamuliwa na chanzo rasmi cha umma. Hakuna kete, hakuna sloti. Ni uhakika wako tu.
sw.s1b: Kila soko ni swali moja lenye majibu mawili. Weka dau unalotaka kwa shilingi. Sindano inaonyesha pesa za umati zilipo tayari.
sw.s2b: Kila soko huamuliwa na chanzo cha umma kilichotajwa: mamlaka ya hali ya hewa, msimamo wa ligi, kiwango cha kati cha Benki Kuu ya Tanzania. Afisa mmoja huthibitisha, au wawili pale idhini ya maafisa wawili imewashwa.
sw.s3b: Dau hugawanywa kwa wote waliopatia, ukiondoa kamisheni ya 13% inayochukuliwa kutoka upande ulioshindwa pekee. Ushindi huingia kwenye salio lako la 50pick, tayari kutolewa kwa pesa ya simu.

sw.dashed: Mstari wa vitone: bei raundi hii ilipofunguliwa.
